unsupported: Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Mililani, Hawaii, American Electric Company, LLC has spent more than seven decades as a licensed electrical contractor serving the islands.
The company began as a local electrical service provider and has grown into a full-service firm handling industrial, commercial, and residential projects across the state.

Customers span homeowners, business owners, property managers, and general contractors in sectors such as alternative energy, industrial manufacturing, power generation, data centers, and commercial real estate.
